items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: it was just myself and her and I brought this amp in and they put the mic in the front

ctx.x: Ginger was her name and she broke away from her two sisters and it was just myself and her and I brought this amp in and they put the mic in the front and he said it was the quietest amp he ever heard, the engineer, which was — because usually they always have a hiss or a hum, but that amp was quiet and I sold that amp. I’m sorry I ever sold that amp many years ago. I wish I still had it.
